description: Searches the site's pages and returns the passages that answer, each with its URL and section anchor, and a confidence. Use it for facts about the product: can it do X, a feature, integrations, security, GDPR, a sector. Steps in the app: comment_faire; prices: voir_offres or devis; comparison: comparer. Returns excerpts: read the page with lire_page before stating a detail they lack. Confidence moyenne or faible: first say what the site does not cover, then give the closest page.

langue.description: Language of the buyer's question (en, fr, es): always pass it, the pages and answers are in this language.

limite.description: Maximum number of passages (1 to 10, default 5).

requete.description: The buyer's question or its key words, in the language of the answer.

name: chercher
title: Search the site
